native.ma_profile: Actual standard serial V1.02 implementation or explicitly registered extension.
native.ma_implementation_class: Actual ASCII requires Regular class; Basic implements RTU only.
native.ma_mode: Actual ASCII transmission; RTU is generic device factory mode, not selected ASCII mode.
native.ma_role: Actual serial bus master initiates one transaction; slave owns unique address.
native.ma_phy: Actual separately qualified RS485 two/four wire or point-to-point RS232; four-wire multipoint is not RS422.
native.ma_parity: Actual matching device serial parity; EVEN default, NONE needs two stops.
native.ma_exchange: Actual serial unicast request/reply or broadcast write without reply.
native.ma_phase: Actual request/normal response/exception; function namespace and PDU length depend phase.
native.ma_function_kind: Actual public assigned versus user-defined or registered extension function.
native.ma_termination: Actual per-pair termination method; resistor150 or polarization-qualified RC120/1nF.
native.ma_cable: Actual cable qualification, not a universal length at any baud rate.
native.ma_word_order: Actual multi-register vendor type/word order; standard big endian applies within a16bit register.
native.ma_revision: Actual standard/device/firmware revisions, independent of application industry.
native.ma_network_id: Actual canonical serial bus identity and master/slave ownership.
native.ma_binding_source: Actual selected serial interfaces, mode, parity, baud and physical path.
native.ma_device_source: Actual slave firmware/capabilities/address and master configuration.

native.ma_mapping_source: Actual coil/register/object namespace, zero-based PDU address and vendor multiword types.
native.ma_schedule_source: Actual one-master transactions, replies/no-replies, gaps, timers, retries and processing bounds.

native.ma_delimiter_source: Actual FC8/subfunction3 changed LF agreement at all selected endpoints.

native.ma_function_source: Actual supported public/user-defined function, diagnostics/MEI or variable file/event codec.

native.ma_turnaround_ms: Actual broadcast processing wait before next request, not automatic100mscapacity.
native.ma_tx_baud_bps: Actual observed transmitter baud respects better than1percent error.

native.ma_trunk_m: Actual trunk length depends rate, cable and loads;1000m only qualified<=9600/AWG26.

native.ma_changed_delimiter: Actual nondefault LF configured by documented diagnostic command.
native.ma_listen_only: Actual addressed slave listen-only state; only restart command processed, no reply.
native.ma_polarization: Actual device requires and bus implements single-location polarization.
native.ma_common: Actual common third/fifth conductor implemented, independent cable shield.
native.ma_shielded: Actual serial cable shielded and protective-ground arrangement.
native.ma_four_wire_as_two: Actual 4W used2W modified wiring halves qualified maximum length.
